title: LOCAL: Health-data unit test hardening + service split
description:
Source: `docs/IMPROVEMENTS_LOCAL.md`

Goal: Achieve near-100% unit test coverage for health-data sync/ingest logic by splitting `HealthDataService` into testable units, adding explicit domain error types, and standardizing deterministic time usage via `src/common/utils/date-utils.ts`.

Non-goals: Any real-provider OAuth/browser flows; CI integration testing (covered in separate story).

features.title: Define domain error taxonomy for health-data sync/ingest (typed errors)
features.description:
From `docs/IMPROVEMENTS_LOCAL.md`.

- Introduce explicit error types for sync/ingest (e.g. ProviderAuthError, ProviderRateLimitError, ProviderTransientError, DataValidationError, PersistenceError).
- Ensure mapping to stored sync-error state is consistent and unit-testable.

Acceptance:
- Unit tests cover error mapping for each error type.
- No behavior change in external API; just clearer classification + tests.

features.title: Standardize deterministic 'now' usage via src/common/utils/DateUtils.ts
features.description:
From `docs/IMPROVEMENTS_LOCAL.md`.

- Establish project-wide convention: time-dependent logic uses `DateUtils` helpers (and a `now()` helper there if needed).
- Add/adjust tests to mock/spyon `DateUtils` `now()` (or equivalent) rather than relying on real clock.

Acceptance:
- Health-data unit tests contain no flaky real-time dependencies.
- Documented convention is applied in health-data module code.

features.title: Refactor: extract daily aggregate writer from HealthDataService
features.description:
From `docs/IMPROVEMENTS_LOCAL.md` service split.

- Move daily deep-merge logic into a dedicated service/class/function.
- Ensure canonical precedence rules are explicit and unit-tested.

Acceptance:
- Existing behavior preserved.
- Dedicated unit tests cover merge/precedence edge cases.

features.title: Refactor: extract raw payload persistence writer from HealthDataService
features.description:
From `docs/IMPROVEMENTS_LOCAL.md` service split.

- Isolate raw provider payload persistence (per-hour/per-day raw writes) into a dedicated unit.

Acceptance:
- Unit tests validate raw write decisions and keying (hourKey/dayKey, etc.).

features.title: Refactor: extract sync-state/cursor writer from HealthDataService
features.description:
From `docs/IMPROVEMENTS_LOCAL.md` service split.

- Isolate cursor + sync-state transitions (success/failure, lastSync timestamps, error persistence) into dedicated unit.

Acceptance:
- Unit tests cover cursor updates, idempotency expectations, and failure-state persistence.

features.title: Unit test matrix: sync ingest happy path + multi-window enumeration
features.description:
From `docs/IMPROVEMENTS_LOCAL.md`.

- Add unit tests for sync across multiple date windows (e.g. enumerateUtcDayWindows usage) and correct adapter calls.

Acceptance:
- Tests cover: single-day, multi-day, clamped windows, empty windows.

features.title: Unit test matrix: persistence behavior for daily/raw writes (including partial failures)
features.description:
From `docs/IMPROVEMENTS_LOCAL.md`.

- Cover cases where one write fails (daily vs raw) and ensure error classification + sync-state are correct.

Acceptance:
- Tests explicitly assert which writes are attempted, and what is recorded on error.

features.title: Unit test matrix: idempotency + duplicate data handling
features.description:
From `docs/IMPROVEMENTS_LOCAL.md`.

- Ensure re-running sync with same windows/payload does not create inconsistent state.

Acceptance:
- Tests validate stable outputs for repeated inputs.
